name: pos-monarca
description: POS y gestión hotelera para Monarca Hotel Boutique

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install
scripts.dev: npm --prefix backend run dev & npm --prefix frontend run dev -- --host
scripts.start: npm run build && npm --prefix backend start
scripts.demo: VITE_DEMO=1 npm run build && MONARCA_DEMO=1 npm --prefix backend start
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test --
scripts.lint: frontend/node_modules/.bin/eslint shared backend eslint.config.js && frontend/node_modules/.bin/prettier --check shared backend/src backend/test && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.format: npm --prefix frontend run format && frontend/node_modules/.bin/prettier --write shared backend/src backend/test
